snippet.title: Official: The Dark Meadow 'Deluxe Edition for Android' Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Hit Mobile game The Dark Meadow by Phosphor Games Studio is coming to Android in early 2012!  

Just announced during the Spike TV Video Game Awards 2011, the Android version will deliver enhanced visuals and physics resulting from the integration of nVidia's latest technology, the Tegra 3 chip, as well as new gameplay features including new game modes, story elements, levels and characters.
